title: Application errors
coverage: Recorded observations, not a complete history. Runtime categories are collected after this feature starts, retained for 30 days with a 1,000-group cap. Jobs and audit observations use their existing retention.
count_help: observations in the displayed groups. One incident can produce multiple observations; these are not unique incident counts.
empty: No recorded observations match these filters.
privacy: This view excludes raw error text, request data, credentials, report content and job payloads. Recorded does not mean resolved. Job state is current; audit entries are historical events. No automatic retry or correction is performed here.
last_write: Last successful collector write or cleanup (UTC)
no_successful_write: No successful write recorded in this process
